talk.transcript: Today, we will explore the concept of photosynthesis, a critical process that allows plants to convert sunlight into energy. During photosynthesis, chlorophyll in the leaves captures sunlight, which is then used to convert carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil into glucose and oxygen. This process not only provides energy for the plant but also produces oxygen that is essential for most life on Earth. Understanding photosynthesis helps us appreciate the role of plants in our ecosystem and their importance in sustaining life.
